description.value: Bean Scene North is a specialty coffee shop in Kelowna's North End, positioned near the Memorial Arena, the Kelowna Library, and the Rotary Centre for the Arts, making it a convenient cultural-district stop. It is part of the multi-location Bean Scene Coffee Works brand, which is a pioneer of the Third Wave Coffee movement in the Okanagan and operates its own small-batch roastery. The shop serves house-made baked goods prepared fresh daily from scratch using real, locally sourced ingredients.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Bean Scene North is a real, operating coffee shop at 1399 Ellis Street in Kelowna's North End, with phone and email matching OSM tags. No cyclist-specific amenities (bike parking, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi, charging) are mentioned anywhere on the website or in OSM tags, so all amenity fields remain null per absence-of-evidence rules. The bakery subpage confirms in-house baked goods made from scratch.
